description: Stage undoing one website edit. Without edit_id it targets the latest edit not yet undone; edit_id picks an older one from list_website_edits. SiteMe restores the website to how it was right before that edit, so later edits made after it are also rolled back, and for an older edit the consequence lists each later edit that is lost. Returns intent, expires_at and consequence: the edit's request and time, what is rolled back, and that the undo is free (it does not count against the 100 website edits a month and does not give the used edit back). Requires company:write; no plan is needed, so an owner can still undo after leaving Pro. confirm_undo_website_edit applies it after approval.
name: prepare_undo_website_edit
title: Prepare a website undo
